summary: Replaced per-event output with revisable connected-component sessions, atomic proposal and revision handling, monotone explicit watermarks, and permanent finalization. Added regression coverage for bridges, splits, lateness, sealed boundaries, tombstones, replay conflicts, ordering, and input independence.
